utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely, and a few folks already signed up to help. I can swing by later if you want the latest updates.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Did they actually get enough people signed up, or is it still a maybe?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s still a maybe, but it sounds like they’re close — a couple more helpers and they should be set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word and repeat the plan to everyone on the block.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I might miss a few details, so that helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ll keep repeating the plan around the block and make sure everyone hears the details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Probably the leaky faucet first, then the loose step by the porch.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—I’ll grab a wrench and take the faucet first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out a bit with the repair drive—just tell me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we’re short on duct tape, batteries, and a couple of flashlights. If you can bring any of those, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring duct tape and a couple batteries. I’ll swing by with them soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate, but I need to know the school pickup window first. What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m thinking around 3:30 to 5:30, after pickup but before dinner. Does that window work for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that should work for me. I can plan around pickup and be there in that window.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a simple plan for the repair drive, so I know what to bring and when to be there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll put together a simple plan and let you know what to bring and when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Oren. Just let me know the time and the list, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Pia, you should come by the repair drive—everyone’s pitching in, and it should be a nice little neighborhood get-together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I might, if I can sort out the timing and parking first. What time are you starting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re starting at 10 a.m. on Saturday, and there should be a few spots open nearby. If parking’s tight, I can save you a hand with the timing when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout—what time should I stop by?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Come by at 2, Nell—we’ll be set up and ready to go. I’m really glad you’re stopping by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll be there at 2. Thanks, Rosa!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the date, time, and what kind of repairs you want to focus on? I’d like to make sure we get the details right before we plan anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I’m thinking Saturday morning around 10, and I’d love to focus on small home fixes like leaky faucets, loose cabinet doors, and a few patch-up jobs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds clear — Saturday morning around 10 for small home fixes like faucets, cabinet doors, and patch-up jobs. I’ll keep that in mind and make sure the details stay straight.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I’ll need to keep it low-key today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries — I can swing by late and keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. That works for me—just let me know when you’re close.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — if you need any tools for the repair drive, I’m happy to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — do you have a drill and a set of screwdrivers I can borrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet — I’ve got both, and I can drop them off when you need them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive location noted—where should I drop it off?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Drop it by my front porch whenever you can—I'll grab it when I'm back.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll leave it by your front porch.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over my tool kit if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be really helpful, thanks. I can swing by when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll set it out and be ready when you come by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just want to make sure we’ve got the timing and drop-off details sorted before I commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, let’s confirm the timing and drop-off details first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — what time are we aiming for, and where should I drop everything off?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be wonderful, Jules — thank you. I’ll send you the details so you can share them around.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, send them over and I’ll pass them along. Happy to help get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of supplies for the repair drive—what do you need me to check?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’d be great — could you check if we’ve got enough screws, tape, and a couple of spare bulbs?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I’ll check our screws, tape, and spare bulbs and let you know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — I’ve heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout so far. I can swing by later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be great, Tess—thank you. If you can check what’s still needed after school pickup, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll check after school pickup and let you know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: If you can bring a few basic tools, some work gloves, and any spare screws or nails you have, that would be a huge help. I’ll make sure we’ve got the rest covered.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring some basic tools, work gloves, and any spare screws or nails I can find.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — could you help sort the donated parts by type and set aside anything broken?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated parts by type and set aside anything broken.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—everyone’s welcome, and I’d love for you to come by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks Quinn — I’ve heard a little about it, so I’ll try to stop by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Nell — I hope you can make it! If you do, just swing by anytime and bring a neighbor along too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive location—where should I drop off the items?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Drop them off at the community hall on Maple Street, by the side entrance. I’ll be there from 9 to 11, so just leave them with me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll bring them to the side entrance at the community hall on Maple Street between 9 and 11.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — is the repair drive still on for Saturday, and do you need any extra tools or supplies from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — yes, Saturday still works. If you could bring a screwdriver set and some zip ties, that would be great.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring a screwdriver set and zip ties on Saturday. Anything else you want me to grab?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like a good turn-out so far — I can swing by later and see if they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be real helpful, Ira — thank you. I keep losing track of who’s doing what, so it’s good to have you there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’m heading out for errands now, and I’ll stop by the repair drive on my way back to check in.
